title: A headline states how many cells it was chosen from and survives correction
description:
Feature: Headline selection
  Scenario: Correction applied
    Given a stereotype with five wordings scored on one model
    When the headline is chosen
    Then only a wording whose Holm-adjusted p-value is under 0.05 may headline
    And the other wordings are shown beside it
  Scenario: Headline copy
    Given any headline on the site
    When I read it
    Then it says the largest of N cells it was chosen from

comments.author: home
comments.text: Board headlines survive Holm's correction and say 'the largest of N'. Released via PR #110.
